description: Header file defining interface for WLD monitor functionalities, including initialization, destruction, status updates, notifications, debugging, stopping, and configuration of monitor objects.

methods.name: wld_mon_initMon
methods.description: Initializes a monitor object with specified parameters.

methods.name: wld_mon_destroyMon
methods.description: Destroys a monitor object, freeing resources.

methods.name: wld_mon_writeActive
methods.description: Sets the active state of the monitor.

methods.name: wld_mon_sendUpdateNotification
methods.description: Sends an update notification for the monitor.

methods.name: wld_mon_debug
methods.description: Outputs debug information for the monitor.

methods.name: wld_mon_setEnable_pwf
methods.description: Enables or disables the monitor via property write function.

methods.name: wld_mon_setInterval_pwf
methods.description: Sets the monitoring interval via property write function.
